alternatives.name: Use comments or naming conventions
alternatives.description: Mark overrides with comments like # override or naming conventions.
alternatives.reason_rejected: Comments aren't checkable by type checkers. A decorator provides a machine-verifiable contract that the method actually overrides something in a parent class.

alternatives.name: Implicit override detection
alternatives.description: Let type checkers automatically detect overrides by comparing method names with parent classes.
alternatives.reason_rejected: Accidental overrides (naming collisions) would go undetected. Explicit @override makes the intent clear and catches cases where the parent method is removed or renamed.
